svg.aria-label: Davit Toroyan, AI Full-Stack Engineer in Yerevan. I build and maintain web products for businesses, from storefronts and admin panels to back ends, and add AI and automation where they save people time. At WaveIT, a digital agency, I've worked on 29 client websites and online stores since 2024: Next.js apps, custom WordPress and WooCommerce themes, Laravel and OpenCart stores. I work AI-first with Claude Code and Cursor and review every change myself before it ships. Client code is private; I'm glad to walk through my part of it on a call.
